{{Quote|What are you doing here?|Palinx|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Palinx''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] who served in the [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Imperial Navy]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]]. Stationed aboard the [[Treasure ship|treasury ship]] [[King's Ransom (treasury ship)|''King's Ransom'']] in [[3642 BBY]], he tried to apprehend intruders, but was convinced to surrender and was tied up by the [[Captain/Legends|Captain]].

==Behind the scenes==
Female players can choose to flirt with him. If the player chooses to flirt with him, he will get killed by [[Vaz Traniff|Vaz]]. The player can choose to kill him for Dark Side points.
